verdict.rationale: Egnyte is a content and file platform, so an incremental-sync (cursor/delta) API is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack describes a delta or cursor endpoint that returns only changes since the last call. Workflow webhooks (docs-7) belong to a different story, and the block streaming and snapshot items are adjacent features, not change-feed APIs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sync efficiently — a cursor/delta endpoint returns only what changed since my last call instead of forcing a full re-crawl
